Brief docs/architecture-briefs/2026-08-06-fix-system-auditor-notebook-compose-actuator-and-immutability-blindspot.md (dispatched via docs/signals/2026-08-06-fix-system-auditor-notebook-compose-actuator.json). agent-father landed everything in its own commit_zone (docs/agents/, .claude/skills/, .claude/agents/ — see .claude/skills/commit-boundary/SKILL.md zone table); scripts/ is outside that zone (repeated precedent: commit c72b5ca34 'scripts/ is developer's zone', notebook entries TE-T02/TE-T12/TE-T14/TE-T21) so the remaining 3 fixes need a developer dispatch. Please triage into the dev-team chain.

DONE by agent-father (in-zone):
- Fix E: collapsed the conflicting Write/Edit compose-step specs to Write-only in .claude/skills/notebook-write/SKILL.md AC-3 Step 2 (was: Edit-with-whole-file-old_string as primary, Write demoted to 'Alternative' — now matches docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/main.md, which already used Write alone). +size-justification header (201L, 1 over the 200L skill-file cap).
- Fix A (flow-doc + interim mitigation portion only — the script itself is out-of-zone, see below): docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/main.md notebook-write step now (1) captures a deterministic PRE_HEADINGS/PRE_COUNT bash snapshot at Step 1a (real tool call, not narrated), and (2) runs a new mandatory BLOCKING Step 2a after the settled Write: computes EXPECTED_DROPS = max(0, PRE_COUNT+1-3) purely from the pre-write heading count (never from the compose step's own self-report of what it dropped) and compares it against ACTUAL_DROPS (comm -23 on heading sets); on mismatch it echoes '[notebook-compose-guard] ABORT ...' and runs `git checkout -- <notebook>` to revert BEFORE any commit is attempted. This would have caught the 0fcc6a5d2 shape (PRE_COUNT too low to require any drop, but a heading vanished anyway) at the pre-commit-attempt stage instead of landing it. This is a stopgap only — it still runs inside the same LLM-narrated flow-step envelope the brief's Finding 1 flags as unreliable-by-construction; it does NOT replace Fix A proper.
- Fix D (documented-policy portion only — runtime enforcement is out-of-zone, see below): docs/agents/tools/package/system-auditor.md Bash row now explicitly lists `bash scripts/auditor-notebook-commit.sh ...` as the ONE authorized git write and explicitly FORBIDS any raw/narrated git add|commit on the notebook path outside that script, citing the 2026-08-06 incident. docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/main.md's Commit step now carries an explicit MANDATORY/NEVER-raw-git-commit callout with the same citation. This is a stronger written contract, not a technical control — see ask 4 below for the actuator.

NEEDS DEVELOPER (outside agent-father's commit_zone — scripts/):

1) Fix A primary — new scripts/notebook-compose.sh <notebook-path> <new-section-body-file> [max-sections=3] [section-cap=60], mirroring scripts/auditor-notebook-commit.sh's precedent exactly (same header-comment style, same 'model calls ONE script, branches on stdout marker' contract). Spec per the brief: takes ONLY the already-authored new-section text; mechanically reads the current file, parses '## ' boundaries, derives/consults this file's newest-first/oldest-first convention (REUSE the self-deriving-from-headings + docs/data/notebook-section-order.json tie-break logic already proven in scripts/agents-flow/notebook-auto-prune.sh — do not reimplement a second, divergent copy), enforces the 3-section retention steady state + AC-2b sub-block intra-prune + 60L/200L caps, and performs ONE settled write via mktemp+mv (never a Claude Write/Edit tool call). Once this lands, docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/main.md's Step 1/Step 2/Step 2a (all three, including agent-father's interim Step 2a gate above, which this script supersedes) collapse to one script invocation + marker branch, same shape as the existing Commit step — that main.md rewire is back in agent-father's zone and agent-father will do it once the script exists and its marker contract is confirmed.

2) Fix B — scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit `_check_notebook_immutability` (~lines 244-331): a dated heading present at HEAD but absent from staged is currently always treated as an authorized 'dropped whole' with zero corroboration. Add a size-shrinkage check: when such a heading disappears, verify the staged file's total line count shrank by ~that HEAD section's own line span (heading through the line before the next heading/EOF), net of the new cycle's own added lines under the existing retention arithmetic. No shrinkage (file same size or grew, as in 0fcc6a5d2: 80->81L) -> flag a new, distinct violation class ('notebook-heading-orphaned-body') rather than silently passing.

3) Fix C — do NOT flip GIT_NOTEBOOK_IMMUTABILITY_MODE yet, fleet-wide or scoped. Live evidence gathered this session (bash scripts/audits/verify-notebook-immutability-gate.sh, full corpus, run 2026-08-06T07:0x-07:1xZ): DATED-HEADING-SCOPED (the currently-deployed, dated-heading-only logic) reads 33 reject(s) across 13 files over each file's last 8 commits -- NOT 0, which is the skill doc's own stated bar for reject-mode (.claude/skills/notebook-write/SKILL.md AC-2a). Critically, docs/agent-memory/notebooks/system-auditor.md itself -- the very file this incident is about, and the brief's suggested reject-mode pilot scope -- shows 3 of its own last 8 commits already REJECT under the current algorithm (57681e89ffdf, 423596abed1e, 1697b1fb2a6f), so even a system-auditor.md-only scoped flip is not clean today. Re-run the replay script after Fix B lands AND those 3 (plus the other 10 files') flagged commits are individually inspected per the script's own instructions (`git show <parent>:<file>` vs `git show <commit>:<file>`, distinguishing real violations from the two known false-positive classes) before considering any reject-mode flip.

4) Fix D technical enforcement — two independent options, both outside agent-father's reach: (a) an actual Bash-command allow-list/PreToolUse-style hook enforcing the FORBIDDEN list agent-father just documented in docs/agents/tools/package/system-auditor.md (infra/hook work), or (b) mint a recurring-bug ticket on docs/data/orch/orch-state.json .task_board -- prior_warns=7 already crossed the fleet's 2+ recurring-bug-escalation threshold independently of this brief, and orch-state.json write is explicitly in commit_zone.excluded for agent-father. Recommend po mint (b) at minimum even if (a) is deferred.
